criteriaNotes.0_hash_check: pixel_sha256 computed for all 5 PNGs via object_gate.pixel_sha256 at review time.
criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: All five are 3/4: top planes + front faces only, no side/iso faces.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Ramps, outline and shading steps match v5 stone and the harbour brazier 7513/7514 side by side.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: Braziers read as laid with fuel; dais reads raised with front face and steps in both room mocks.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Brazier grounded with shadow; riser L/centre/R/steps join seamlessly with each other and the dais top.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: No stray pixels, stubs or jaggies found.

items.name: 큰 돌 화로(꺼짐, 2칸, 버들항 돌) (great stone brazier)
reasons: 3/4 correct: elliptical rim top visible as a plane, bowl/column/foot show only front faces with top-light lips; no side faces.
Style matches the harbour brazier 7513/7514 exactly in ramp (blue-grey slate), dark outline, 4-5 shading steps, cut-end log highlights; no flat fills or noise.

At 1x in mock-gate the four bowls clearly read as filled with crossed logs on a charcoal/ash bed - 'laid, ready to light', not empty urns. Nit (non-blocking): the ash bed is closer to mid-grey than pale; a few more light-grey pixels in the bowl corners would sell 'ash' better.
Grounded on the dais with a soft drop shadow under the foot; footprint 2 tiles, no clipping with neighbours in the mock.
Clean silhouette, no stray pixels; rim ellipse and foot corners stepped cleanly.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(가운데, 1칸) (dais riser stone)
reasons: Overlay correct for 3/4: transparent top rows leave the dais top plane; light edge line + front face of courses + dark bottom shadow = a raised slab front.
Grey-stone ramp, staggered joints, 1px dark course lines, light top lip - consistent with v5 stone pieces; no noise.
In both mocks the dais reads as a raised slab with a front face at 1x.
Tiles seamlessly with itself and with L/R ends; top edge meets the dais checker without a gap.
Clean.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(왼쪽 끝, 1칸) (dais riser stone L)
reasons: Same construction as the centre riser with a left end outline; 3/4 correct.
Style identical to centre piece.
End cap closes the slab front cleanly at 1x.
Joins the centre piece seamlessly (courses and lip continue), sits flush with the dais's left edge in both mocks.
Clean end outline, no stubs.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(오른쪽 끝, 1칸) (dais riser stone R)
reasons: Mirror construction of L with a right end outline; 3/4 correct.
Style identical to centre piece.
End cap reads at 1x.
Joins seamlessly; flush with the dais's right edge in both mocks.
Clean.

items.name: 돌 단 오르는 두 계단(2칸) (dais steps stone)
reasons: Two shallow steps shown as top planes (light treads) + short front faces, cheeks either side - correct 3/4, no side faces.
Same ramp/outline as the riser; tread highlights and joints consistent.
At 1x in mock-gate and mock-vault a lighter notch with two treads reads as steps up onto the dais; weakest piece at 1x but legible.
Cheeks align with the riser courses on both sides; equal-height steps fill the riser height without overhang.
Clean; cheek lines straight, no stray pixels.
